datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a regular monthly schedule across Burkina Faso administrative units. The spatial data represents medium-term projections of acute food insecurity phases under different scenarios, with classifications standardized using the IPC scale and linked to geographic boundaries.
